Stemmle and starring Heidemarie Hatheyer, Wilhelm Borchert and Werner Hinz. It is based on the 1929 novel" Morning of Life" by Kristmann Gudmundsson. It is set amongst feuding Scandinavian fishing families. The film's sets were designed by the art directors Helmut Nentwig and Karl Weber.
